text: Tina, Nancy and their friends all dream of [a disfigured man with a bladed glove|images|weapons and tools] stalking them through a boiler room, and when Tina is slashed in her sleep, [the wounds follow her out of the dream|rules|reality comes apart]. Nancy fights sleep with caffeine and burns herself awake, until her mother admits that Fred Krueger, a child murderer freed on a technicality, was [burned alive by the parents of Elm Street|wrong|sins of the ancestors]. Now he [hunts their children through their dreams|wants|revenge for a wrong].
